name: lx-dsh
description: LX-DSH — native desktop client for DeepSeek Harness (dsh web)
author: Laoxiao7274

scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder --win --dir && node scripts/post-vendor.mjs && set ELECTRON_BUILDER_COMPRESSION_LEVEL=0&& electron-builder --win nsis --prepackaged dist/win-unpacked
scripts.dist:fast: npm run build && electron-builder --win --dir && node scripts/post-vendor.mjs && node scripts/make-portable.mjs
scripts.dist:update: npm run build && electron-builder --win --dir && node scripts/post-vendor.mjs && node scripts/build-update.mjs
scripts.dist:full: npm run build && electron-builder --win --dir && node scripts/post-vendor.mjs && set ELECTRON_BUILDER_COMPRESSION_LEVEL=0&& electron-builder --win nsis --prepackaged dist/win-unpacked && node scripts/build-update.mjs && node scripts/make-portable.mjs
